newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Forbes lists in Namibia, Botswana this week.
newsitem.headline: Forbes lists in Namibia, Botswana this week.

text.p: South African financial services firm Forbes Group Ltd said on Monday it will list on the Namibian stock exchange on Tuesday and the Botswanan bourse on Friday.
Earlier this month Forbes announced it planned listings on the two tiny Southern African exchanges, but gave no indication of the dates.
The firm, which only listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange last November, sees the move as part of its plans to expand its interests in Africa.

"We have expanding operations in both Namibia and Botswana employing local people and believe that it is appropriate for our shares to be traded on those exchanges and for Forbes to play a more active role in the economies of Namibia and Botswana," chief executive Paul Heinamann said.
Forbes has employee benefit consulting operations, a short-term insurance brokerage and a reinsurance arm in Namibia.
In Botswana the firm's operations cover short-term insurance, employee benefit consultancy and actuarial services.
Forbes is the latest in a rash of South African firms to seek secondary listings in Botswana and Namibia.
In the past six months diamond giant De Beers Ltd, car rental firm Avis Holdings Ltd and McCarthy Retail Holdings Ltd have all made the move and greatly boosted the market size of the two bourses.
